| # Supported sessions and security access levels {#supported-sessions-and-security-access-levels-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                                 |                                                                                                                                                              |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

The below diagnostics sessions are used by CB-ME:\
 

  ID     Name                        Description
  ------ --------------------------- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  0x01   Default Session             This session automatically enables the server\'s default diagnostics. It remains active only when no other diagnostic session is in progress and is suitable for basic, non-security-critical services (e.g. Device Identification).
  0x02   ProgrammingSession          This session enables all the diagnostic services necessary to safely support the memory programming of the ECU (e.g., flashing software), suspending normal operation during the process.
  0x03   extendedDiagnosticSession   This session unlocks all the advanced diagnostic services (e.g., change in parameters).

 

 

The following table details the UDS sessions and associated security access levels (refer [Access levels](access-levels.html){.topiclink}) required to access and utilize the supported UDS services:

 

+------+--------------------------+---------------------------------------------+-----------------------+
| SID  | Service                  | Session                                     | Security Access Level |
|      |                          +---------+-------------+---------------------+                       |
|      |                          | Default | Programming | Extended Diagnostic |                       |
+======+==========================+=========+=============+=====================+=======================+
| 0x10 | DiagnosticSessionControl | yes     | yes         | yes                 | Not Required          |
+------+--------------------------+---------+-------------+---------------------+-----------------------+
| 0x11 | ECUReset                 | no      | yes         | yes                 | L1, L2                |
+------+--------------------------+---------+-------------+---------------------+-----------------------+
| 0x27 | SecurityAccess           | no      | yes         | yes                 | Not Required          |
+------+--------------------------+---------+-------------+---------------------+-----------------------+
| 0x28 | CommunicationControl     | no      | yes         | yes                 | Not Required          |
+------+--------------------------+---------+-------------+---------------------+-----------------------+
| 0x3E | TesterPresent            | yes     | yes         | yes                 | Not Required          |
+------+--------------------------+---------+-------------+---------------------+-----------------------+
| 0x85 | ControlDTCSetting        | no      | yes         | yes                 | Not Required          |
+------+--------------------------+---------+-------------+---------------------+-----------------------+
| 0x22 | ReadDataByIdentifier     | yes     | yes         | yes                 | Not Required          |
+------+--------------------------+---------+-------------+---------------------+-----------------------+
| 0x2E | WriteDataByIdentifier    | no      | yes         | yes                 | L1                    |
+------+--------------------------+---------+-------------+---------------------+-----------------------+
| 0x31 | RoutineControl           | no      | yes         | no                  | L1                    |
+------+--------------------------+---------+-------------+---------------------+-----------------------+
| 0x34 | RequestDownload          | no      | yes         | no                  | L1                    |
+------+--------------------------+---------+-------------+---------------------+-----------------------+
| 0x36 | TransferData             | no      | yes         | no                  | L1                    |
+------+--------------------------+---------+-------------+---------------------+-----------------------+
| 0x37 | RequestTransferExit      | no      | yes         | no                  | L1                    |
+------+--------------------------+---------+-------------+---------------------+-----------------------+
| 0xBE | RexrothUDSSecrets        | no      | yes         | no                  | L2                    |
+------+--------------------------+---------+-------------+---------------------+-----------------------+
